text: Retrieval augmented generation grounds a language model with passages retrieved from an external corpus.
BM25 is a lexical ranking function that scores documents using term frequency and inverse document frequency.
Dense retrieval represents queries and documents as vectors, then finds similar vectors with a similarity metric.
Reciprocal rank fusion combines ranked result lists without requiring score calibration between retrievers.
Chunk size controls how much context is stored in one retrieval unit; overlap preserves context across chunk boundaries.
Mean reciprocal rank rewards systems that place the first relevant result near the top of the ranking.
Normalized discounted cumulative gain uses graded relevance and discounts useful documents found lower in a result list.
A vector index can improve nearest-neighbor search speed but may consume substantial disk space and memory.
RunPod provides on-demand GPU pods useful for model training, inference, and large embedding experiments.
JupyterLab provides an interactive notebook environment for data science and machine learning experimentation.
